---
title: "How do I keep only rows that meet a condition?"
---

## What the question asks

How do I keep only rows that meet a condition?

## Steps in RStudio

1. Read the actual column names.

2. Write the condition with >, >=, ==, or %in%.

3. Inspect the remaining rows and count them.

## Runnable example

```{r}
d <- data.frame(id=1:5, rainfall_mm=c(1,0,7,4,10))
wet <- subset(d,rainfall_mm>=5)
print(wet)
print(nrow(wet))
```

## Interpret the result

Two rows have rainfall of at least 5 mm. The >= operator includes observations exactly equal to the threshold.

## Check before applying this to real data

Compare nrow() before and after filtering, and confirm the condition includes or excludes the boundary correctly.
